title: Scenic Half Marathon Krabi 2026 Review: Ao Nang's Beachfront 21K
seo_title: Scenic Half Marathon Krabi 2026 Review | Ao Nang Thailand
meta_description: The Scenic Half Marathon Krabi 2026: September 13 at Noppharatthara Beach, Ao Nang. A single-distance 21.1K on one of Thailand's most beautiful coastlines — registration open.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at Noppharatthara Beach in Ao Nang, Krabi, this single-distance half marathon is part of the Scenic Marathon Series. Registration open. A beachfront 21K on one of Thailand's most celebrated coastlines.
verdict: The Scenic Half Marathon Krabi lives up to its name: a single-distance 21.1K starting at Noppharatthara Beach in Ao Nang — the gateway to the limestone karst islands of the Andaman Sea. Part of the Scenic Marathon Series (which also includes Chiang Mai and Nakhon Phanom), this is a focused, single-distance event with registration open. September in Krabi is the late rainy season — expect humid conditions and possible showers, but also lush green landscapes and fewer tourists. For runners wanting a beachfront Thai half marathon with genuine Andaman Sea scenery, this is a standout.

sections.heading: Ao Nang: Krabi's Beachfront Gateway
paragraphs: Noppharatthara Beach in Ao Nang is the main departure point for Krabi's famous four-island tours — a beachfront strip with limestone karsts rising from the Andaman Sea. [1] A half marathon here combines road racing with one of Thailand's most celebrated coastal landscapes. The Scenic Marathon Series' production template — proven at Chiang Mai and Nakhon Phanom — ensures a well-run event.
